confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer draw on [June 2026 Faro crowd prices](https://algarvecircle.com/cost-of-living-in-the-algarve). Cocktail and wine are estimated at roughly 2.7 and 1.3 times beer; the [cocktail sample](https://www.expatistan.com/cost-of-living/faro) is small and postdates July, while a [Faro travel guide](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/guide-to-faro-portugal) provides a wine price range. Accommodation is a general July peak-season estimate and varies substantially by date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use Algarve towns such as Lagos and Portimão as a regional basis, adjusted for Faro's more urban visitor mix and summer demand.
